description: Always-on AI agents from xAI and Cursor that work autonomously across your tools and apps.
notes: This laelluo package is named grok-bot (same as extras). Prefer: scoop install laelluo/grok-bot. Or uninstall the extras package first, then install.
Update with: scoop update grok-bot. Turn OFF in-app auto-update (Settings). In-app NSIS updates write under LocalAppData\Programs\Grok Bot and can fork versions outside Scoop.
User data: AppData\Grok Bot -> persist\roaming. Programs intercept: LocalAppData\Programs\Grok Bot -> persist\programs.
Existing ordinary data directories or foreign/broken links STOP install and are preserved. Follow scoop-admin docs/grok-bot-migration.md (quit app, backup/rename, hash verify). No silent delete.
sand-update-apply-marker.json lives under AppData\Grok Bot; after roaming is mapped it stays in persist. Clear staged NSIS apply only after quit, if a stale stage remains.
Install/update/uninstall refuses while Grok Bot.exe is running; Scoop will not kill the process.
Ordinary uninstall removes owned symlinks only and keeps Scoop persist data.
